Automated translation sync from the Crowdin project, covering every file group in crowdin.yml (Tier A studio UI chrome + Tier B content sidecars). Generated by crowdin-download-translations.yml (spec 046 T038).

READ THIS DIFF BY HAND. Untranslated Tier A strings (packages/studio/src/locales/*/messages.json) arrive as the ENGLISH SOURCE TEXT, not as empty values (skip_untranslated_strings is false, deliberately -- see the note in crowdin.yml). New Tier A strings now reach main with their French already written (i18n-catalog-lint rejects empty target values), and merging uploads that French to Crowdin, so English appearing where French used to be is a defect to resolve before merging, not routine: Crowdin is missing a translation that main has. Usually the upload has not caught up -- re-run crowdin-upload-sources with seed_translations, or restore the French in this branch. Tier B catalogs (content/i18n/<locale>/*.json) go through utilities/content-i18n-normalize first, so an untranslated Tier B key should already read as an empty value here, not English -- if you see English in a Tier B catalog in this diff, that is unexpected and worth a second look. Check that the French you expect to exist is still here, and that no Tier A string has turned into English.
